feature.title: Fix summer2000 beat phase final attempt
feature.request:
Last attempt: fix summer2000's beat phase (tracker plan, after the replan)

Plan one more design to bring summer2000 beat.errorMedianMs from 153.4 ms to 40 ms or less (offline, npm run scorecard), without breaking any passing blocking cell. This is the final bounded attempt: if it misses its pre-registered grid, summer2000 is accepted at its measured value and the tracker is left as it is.

Read first:
- docs/agents/hub-scorecard.md, sections "Tracker plan D11, S1" (the beat trace diagnosis), "Tracker replan, S0" and "Tracker replan, S1 to S4"
- docs/plans/rhythm-tracker-replan/rhythm-tracker-replan.plan.md (decisions, contracts C1 to C4, the critic's findings)

What exists:
- PR #136 (S1, merged or merging): the worklet's band-0 kick events reach BeatTracker.pushKick through RhythmAnalyzer.pushKicks, in arrival order with their own timestamps, from the live path and every offline runner. Nothing reads them on main.
- Local branch replan/s2-kick-model (5eaddde, on top of S1, not pushed): KickPhaseModel (attempt A), KickOffset (attempt B, with the review fix), the C3 constants (all off), the C4 getters, and trace:beats columns for kick support, margin, veto, hold, kick move, first kick move and first time within 40 ms of the taps. It is unmerged and may be reused, changed or dropped.
- Six follow-ups in verified-diamond state (FU-RP-*), mainly for that branch. One matters if the next design builds on it: eval/detect.ts and testSignals.runPipeline never call pushKicks.

What was measured, and why both attempts missed:
- Kick lead: about 0 ms (synthetic -0.2, tapped -0.7). summer2000's kicks sit a median 31 ms before the taps and about 0.3 beat after the tracker's grid. Folded on the grid, only 0.28 of them fall in the best 3-bin window, because the kicks are syncopated throughout.
- Attempt A (veto, fill hold, kick-driven move; 48 pre-registered points): best 142.7 ms, with 13 to 16 blocking failures. The kick move works and lands the grid on the taps (-13.8 ms at 11.4 s). But the fill test (the coefficient of variation of the kick intervals over 4 beats, above 0.25 or 0.4) is true at every beat on a syncopated groove, so the hold freezes the per-beat correction for the whole track. The 470 ms period, 3 ms longer than the tapped 467 ms, then drifts the grid back to 145 to 185 ms off within about 15 beats.
- Attempt B (median kick offset on the analyzer anchor; 6 points): best 98.9 ms. On low-bpm-rnb, lonley and syncopation-no-kick the kicks are not on the tapped beat, so their median moves grids that were right (low-bpm-rnb 148 to 171 ms on every point).
- low-bpm-rnb (24.2 ms) broke under every point of both grids. It has sparse kicks: 13 of 35 taps have one within 150 ms.

The direction the trace points to (a candidate, not a decision): keep A's kick move, but do not freeze during the hold; instead correct each beat toward the nearest kick event in its window, so the period keeps following the kicks. Also gate the model on kick regularity at the beat level (not raw interval spread), so sparse or off-beat kicks (low-bpm-rnb, lonley) never engage it. Weigh this against at least one structurally different option. Do not repeat these measured misses: kick-weighted phase bins, a half-beat flip, a looser streak gate, a kick-preferring correction alone (149.5 ms in D11), a hold decided by interval spread alone, or a single global kick-to-beat offset.

Constraints (carried from the replan):
- tracker.state contract C1 is unchanged. A phase move bumps phaseShiftCount and never gridEpoch; beatCount never decreases.
- Everything is off by default until the enabling slice. Constants live in rhythmConfig.ts, one per line, so --set can override them.
- Prototype offline first, with trace:beats and the full scorecard per grid point. Pre-register one grid before running it, with no post-hoc widening (risk K1).
- AC2 guards: scorecard:check exits 0; low-bpm-rnb stays at 40 ms or less; ac9.dottedChangeCounted stays 1; the synthetic tracks and syncopation-no-kick, syncopationbass, 6-8-time and high-bpm-dnb get no worse; sweep:gate false opens no higher than 3 and 15.
- Budget: total JS at most 341.5 kB (main after #136 is about 338.6), and bench:tracker ratio at most 1.25.
- The tapped .beats.json files and the scorecard targets (v9) do not change. No hub, visualizer, bassGate, worklet or onset-detector changes.
- AGENTS.md rules apply: no per-frame allocation, named exports, comments that explain why, and no links into worktrees.

Deliver a plan with a go/no-go: summer2000 at 40 ms or less with AC2 green on the pre-registered grid, or record the miss and close.

problem.statement: On summer2000 the beat tracker's grid sits about 0.3 beat off the tapped beats (beat.errorMedianMs 153.4 ms against a 40 ms target). Two kick-based attempts missed: A froze the per-beat correction for the whole track, B moved grids that were already right on tracks whose kicks are off the beat (low-bpm-rnb 24.2 to 148-171 ms).

options.summary: Keep attempt A's kick move, delete the fill hold, and add a per-beat pull toward the nearest kick in a window, engaged only when a beat-level gate (fraction of recent beats with a kick at a consistent offset) is open.
approach: Rebase replan/s2-kick-model on main; delete KickOffset and the fill hold/veto code; add pushKicks to eval/detect.ts and testSignals.runPipeline (AC1: all constants off, scorecard equals S0).

In KickPhaseModel keep a preallocated ring of the last KICK_GATE_BEATS beats, each storing (kick found within +/-KICK_WINDOW_MS of the declared beat, signed offset). Written in declareBeat; no allocation.

Gate opens when the hit fraction >= KICK_GATE_FRACTION and the offset spread (max-min or MAD) <= KICK_GATE_SPREAD_MS. Sparse (low-bpm-rnb 13/35), off-beat (lonley) and no-kick tracks fail the fraction or the spread, so they stay on the old path.

Gate closed: declareBeat is unchanged. Gate open: A's one-shot kick move lands the grid, and each beat the phase error is replaced by gain x (nearest kick offset), fed through the existing phase correction and the 0.05 period nudge. That is the part A froze, and it lets the period follow the kicks, so the 470 vs 467 ms drift is corrected.
A phase move goes through the existing shift path: phaseShiftCount++, gridEpoch untouched, beatCount monotonic. The gate closes with hysteresis (reopen needs a full ring) so it cannot chatter.
Pre-register the grid in hub-scorecard.md (below) and commit it. Run each point with a dev-only scorecard --set (D6) plus trace:beats on summer2000 and low-bpm-rnb.
Unit specs with synthetic kick streams (on-beat, syncopated, sparse, off-beat) check the engage/no-engage cases, C1 and no per-frame allocation.

pros: Smallest delta from measured working code (A's move works)
Removes exactly the failure A showed (the freeze)
Gate is evaluated at the beat level, not on raw interval spread
Off-path inert, so AC1 is trivial
cons: Reuses the branch, so the unmerged s2 code ships on a go
Pulling toward the nearest kick is close to the 149.5 ms kick-preferring correction, so it relies on the gate and the one-shot move for the difference
Fixed constants for BEATS and lead limit the grid

Gain 1.0 can destabilise the synthetic tracks

options.summary: A gated kick PLL on the s2 branch: per declared beat, the nearest kick in a window drives separate phase and period trims, engaged only by an N-of-M regularity gate with hysteresis, bounded from the analyzer's grid, released without a jump, never freezing the existing correction.
approach: Reuse s2 KickQueue ring and C4 getters; drop KickOffset and the veto/hold; add pushKicks to eval/detect.ts and testSignals.runPipeline.

In declareBeat, after the existing correction, find the kick nearest the declared beat within +-KICK_WINDOW_MS (ring scan, no allocation). Residual r = kickTime - beatTime - KICK_LEAD_MS (0 measured).

Loop: phaseTrim += KICK_PHASE_GAIN*r applied as a pendingBeat move (phaseShiftCount++, gridEpoch untouched); periodTrim += KICK_PERIOD_GAIN*r/period applied additively to the beat interval, never to the held tempo, so the 4% setTempo hysteresis and re-search never fire.

While engaged the onset-error term in the per-beat nudge keeps running (no hold), so there is no freeze; the kick PLL integrates r to zero, and the period trim removes the 470 vs 467 ms drift by following the kicks every beat.

Gate over the last M=8 beats in a preallocated Float64Array: enter when >=N beats have a kick in window and the MAD of their signed residuals <= KICK_SPREAD_MS; exit when <N-2 beats or MAD > 1.5x bound (hysteresis).
Excursion bounds from the analyzer's own grid: |sum phase moves| <= KICK_MAX_PHASE_MS (200), |periodTrim| <= KICK_MAX_PERIOD_PCT (2%); hitting a bound clamps and counts toward exit.

Disengage: stop kick moves, decay periodTrim to 0 over 4 beats, keep the grid where it is (no jump); the existing correction resumes from there. Pre-register the 24-point grid in hub-scorecard.md before any run.

pros: Fixes the identified root cause of A: no freeze, period keeps following kicks.
Engagement is a function of beat-level kick evidence, not interval spread; off by default and inert at gain 0 (AC1).

cons: Offset-only gating cannot tell a stable off-beat kick (lonley, syncopation-no-kick) from summer2000's stable 0.3-beat offset; they are protected only by regularity, excursion bound and the measured numbers.

Phase and period loops can oscillate at gain 0.9 with the 0.12 period gain.
K1: a single grid may simply miss; D4 applies.

options.summary: Stop correcting phase per beat: fit the period (slope) of kick time against beat slot over a sliding window, apply it past the 4% hysteresis, and keep A's one-shot kick move only for anchoring, engaged only when the fit is tight and dense.
approach: Breaks the assumption that the fix is a per-beat or hold decision: the 470 vs 467 ms period error is a slope error, so fit the slope directly and let phase follow it.

KickGridFit keeps a preallocated ring of the last N (slot, kickTime) pairs. Slot = round((kickTime - anchor) / period) from the current grid; one kick per slot (nearest the median offset). No allocation: Float64Array rings, scalar sums.
Each beat, run two-pass least squares in place: fit time = a + P*slot over all pairs, drop pairs whose residual exceeds KICKFIT_TOL_BEAT x P, refit. Output P, a, inlier count, residual RMS.

Engage only if occupied slots / window >= KICKFIT_MIN_FILL, residual RMS <= tol, and |P - held period| <= KICKFIT_MAX_DEV (2%, so setTempo, rebuild and epoch never fire). Sparse or off-beat tracks fail fill or RMS: low-bpm-rnb has kicks near 13 of 35 taps (0.37), lonley and syncopation-no-kick have no consistent slot offset, so the fit stays idle and the legacy path is untouched.

When engaged, write P into the tracker period and held tempo via a new setFittedPeriod (bypasses hysteresis, keeps C1), and fire A's existing kick move once per engage to anchor phase to the fit intercept. The move bumps phaseShiftCount only.
Disengage (residual or fill lost for 4 beats) returns to the legacy 0.05 nudge with no hold, so nothing freezes; the fill-test CV hold is deleted.
Prototype with trace:beats columns fit period, RMS, fill, engaged; grid below registered in hub-scorecard.md before the first run.

decision_rationale: O2 is the top scorer and removes both measured causes of attempt A's miss in one loop: nothing freezes, and a period trim kept outside the held tempo cancels the 470 vs 467 ms drift every beat without touching setTempo, its 4% hysteresis or gridEpoch. Engagement uses an N-of-M beat-level gate with a spread bound and hysteresis, and excursion clamps bound the damage on a wrong engage. O1 is close to the 149.5 ms kick-preferring correction and has no period path of its own. O3 attacks the slope directly, but needs a new setFittedPeriod that bypasses hysteresis and relies on a slot assignment that a 0.3-beat-off grid biases. O3's diagnostic value is kept cheaply: the trace adds O2's integrated period trim, which is the same slope signal.

design.overview: On the reused replan/s2-kick-model branch (KickOffset, veto and fill hold removed), A's one-shot kick move stays as the entry anchor at the constants A measured working (it landed the grid at -13.8 ms at 11.4 s). After it, a gated kick loop keeps the grid there. Causality (F1): beat k's residual is read at the declaration of beat k+1, when every kick within the window of beat k has arrived, and is applied as a move of pendingBeat. Residual r = nearest kick within KICK_WINDOW_FRAC x period of beat k, minus beat k, minus KICK_LEAD_MS (0), in ms. Loop (F7): phase move = KICK_PHASE_GAIN x r, clamped so the summed moves stay within KICK_MAX_PHASE_FRAC x period of the analyzer's grid; period trim += KICK_PERIOD_GAIN x r / period, as a fraction per beat, clamped to KICK_MAX_PERIOD_PCT; at r of 0.05 beat and gain 0.03 a step is 0.15%, so the loop does not saturate. The trim is added to the beat interval and to lastBeatPeriod, so updatePhase and meter follow it, and it never calls setTempo. Gate (F4): over the last KICK_GATE_M beats, open when at least KICK_GATE_N had a kick in the window and the residual MAD is at most KICK_SPREAD_FRAC x period; close below N-1 or above 1.5x spread; N and M are chosen in the S3 pre-flight so low-bpm-rnb's 0.37 density cannot hold it. While open (F2), a kick move rotates phaseBins and resets phaseWins, and KICK_SUPPRESS_ONSET (0 or 1, a grid dimension) suppresses checkPhase and the onset phase term so old-grid evidence cannot pull the grid back; the period nudge keeps running, so nothing freezes. On close, moves stop and the trim decays to 0 over 4 beats without a jump. Resets (F5): halving, doubling, rebuild, the BEAT_LOST_BEATS re-search and reset() clear the gate ring, the move sum and the trim. KICK_PHASE_GAIN 0 makes everything inert.

design.data: No persisted data. Grid results are recorded as a table in docs/agents/hub-scorecard.md; the baseline cells change only in the enabling slice.
design.ux: On a go, beat-driven motion on summer2000-like syncopated tracks lands on the beat; every other track is unchanged or within its guard.
design.observability: trace:beats columns for engagement, residual and trims; the scorecard json records the --set overrides of each grid point.
design.rollout: S1 merges alone as dev tooling. S2 stays off by default. S3 pre-flight may end the attempt early (no N fits its rule: S6 no-go without a grid run). The grid is committed with its sha recorded before its first run (S4). Go: S5 sets the winner's constants as defaults, re-writes the baseline with no --set, and ships through a normal PR; rollback is reverting the defaults. No-go: S6 records the miss; S2 stays unmerged.

test_strategy.unit: kickPhase.test.ts and beatTracker specs: kicks 0.3 beat after the grid are seen through the deferred residual; on-beat, syncopated, sparse 0.37 with a 2-bar cluster, stable off-beat and none; engage and release with hysteresis; phase bins rotated on a move; phaseShiftCount without gridEpoch; beatCount monotonic; clamps; no-jump release; resets on halving, doubling, rebuild, re-search and reset(); loop stable at the highest grid gains; inert at KICK_PHASE_GAIN 0. run.ts spec: --set with --write-baseline exits non-zero. Re-check the existing it.fails and flip it if fixed.
test_strategy.integration: scorecard with defaults equals S0 cells (AC1); per grid point: full scorecard via --set, scorecard:check, trace:beats on summer2000 and low-bpm-rnb; for the winner also sweep:gate, size and bench:tracker.
test_strategy.e2e: Enabling slice only: npm run build and npm run test:e2e.
test_strategy.manual: Enabling slice: debug:viz on summer2000 and low-bpm-rnb in npm run dev to see the beat land.
test_strategy.non_functional: No per-frame allocation (ring scan per declared beat only); bench:tracker ratio <= 1.25; total JS <= 341.5 kB; coverage >= 95%.

risks.description: The single pre-registered grid misses (all three options were low confidence)
risks.mitigation: Accepted by design: D4 closes with summer2000 at its measured value; no widening.

risks.description: Stable off-beat kicks on lonley or syncopation-no-kick pass the gate and the loop moves a right grid
risks.mitigation: Phase and period clamps; run trace:beats with kickEngaged on all tracks at grid point 1 and record any engagement outside summer2000; the AC2 guards decide, not tuning.

risks.description: low-bpm-rnb engages briefly and leaves its 40 ms budget
risks.mitigation: N of 5 or 6 of 8 with 13/35 kick coverage; guard checked per point.

risks.description: Phase loop and the running period nudge fight, or the onset term pulls the grid back
risks.mitigation: KICK_SUPPRESS_ONSET is a grid dimension; phase bins rotate on each move; stability spec at the highest gains; synthetic tracks no worse is in AC2.

risks.description: The gate never opens on summer2000, making the grid uninformative
risks.mitigation: S3 pre-flight measures occupancy after A's move before any grid point runs; if no N fits its rule the attempt ends as a no-go at once.

risks.description: The pre-flight looks at summer2000 and low-bpm-rnb before the grid, which could leak tuning
risks.mitigation: Its rule is fixed in this plan (smallest N of M 8 with summer2000 occupancy >= 70% of beats after 12 s while no 8-beat window of low-bpm-rnb reaches N-1; spread the 90th percentile of summer2000's residual MAD), it runs no scorecard point, and its output is committed with the grid.

open_questions.question: What is lonley's current beat error and kick regularity? It is not recorded post-merge.

findings.finding: O2 scans for the nearest kick inside declareBeat, 'after the existing correction'. A beat is declared once time >= pendingBeat + BEAT_WINDOW_FRACTION x period (beatTracker.ts:206, 0.2 beat, about 94 ms at 470 ms), and kicks also arrive 2-3 frames after their timestamp (hub-scorecard.md Kick delivery). summer2000's kicks sit about 0.3 beat (about 140 ms) after the grid, so they have not arrived when the beat is declared. The loop only sees the early syncopated kicks before the beat, so it would pull the grid the wrong way. This is the same causality bug the independent review found in attempt B (hub-scorecard.md 1259-1263: 'could only learn offsets up to about 0.15 of a beat'). The plan, C2 and the K5 window argument do not mention it. A window of 130 or 170 ms is meaningless if the kicks are not yet in the ring.
findings.suggestion: Read each beat's kicks one declaration later (as repaired B does), or defer the residual until pendingBeat + window + kick latency. Say so in the S2 objective and add an AC4 spec with a kick 0.3 beat late of the grid.
findings.resolution: Fixed: beat k's residual is read at the declaration of beat k+1, so kicks 0.3 beat late have arrived; AC4 spec with kicks 0.3 beat after the grid.

findings.finding: The root cause that O2's period trim relies on does not add up, and the plan does not address the other movers. A 3 ms per beat period error moves the grid about 30 to 50 ms over the 10 to 17 beats between 11.4 s and 16-19 s. The trace shows the grid 145 to 185 ms off (hub-scorecard.md 1281). The remaining 100 ms or more came from something else. A 'gives way to a sustained envelope phase', and checkPhase (beatTracker.ts:333-367) moves pendingBeat back by any offset of at least PHASE_MIN_SHIFT 0.25 beat after 4 wins at 1.15x. summer2000's offset is about 0.3 beat, past that threshold. O2 keeps the onset correction running at BEAT_PHASE_GAIN 0.4 (rhythmConfig.ts:167). Kick moves do not rotate phaseBins or reset phaseWins, so the onset evidence for the old grid can pull the grid straight back. The period trim may be fixing a minor part of the drift.
findings.suggestion: Before S3, read the S2 trace of A on summer2000 to see which mover undid the move (checkPhase shift, onset nudge, or the period). Specify in S2 how kick moves treat phaseBins and phaseWins, or suppress checkPhase and the onset phase term while the gate is open. Add an AC4 spec for it.
findings.resolution: Fixed: S3 first reads A's trace to name the mover; kick moves rotate phaseBins and reset phaseWins; KICK_SUPPRESS_ONSET (checkPhase and onset phase term off while engaged) is a grid dimension; spec added.

findings.finding: Nothing shows the gate can open on summer2000, and a miss may be uninformative. Only 0.28 of its kicks fall in the best 3-bin window. The gate needs 5 or 6 of 8 beats with a kick in the window and a MAD of at most 45 ms, both fixed. The window is measured against the current grid, which is 140 ms off; window 130 cannot hold the mean kick (K5). With window 170 (+-0.36 beat) a syncopated groove has a kick on both sides of the grid, so 'nearest' can flip between them and inflate the MAD. The grid varies only N and the window, and leaves M and the spread, which decide whether the gate opens, fixed. If the gate never opens, all 24 points equal S0 and the last attempt is wasted. O2's 'A's one-shot kick move stays available as the entry anchor' is not in S2, C3 (no KICK_MOVE_* or support-floor constants listed) or the grid. It is unclear what moves the grid onto the kicks first.
findings.suggestion: Add a read-only pre-flight before registering: the distribution of nearest-kick residuals and N-of-8 occupancy on summer2000 and low-bpm-rnb, from kicks already in the s2 trace. It moves no grid and runs no scorecard point, so it is not a K1 breach. Choose the gate dimensions and the entry mechanism from it, and either list the entry move's constants in C3 or drop the sentence.
findings.resolution: Fixed: A's kick move is the named entry anchor with its constants in C3; a read-only pre-flight with a rule fixed in this plan (K6) sets N, M and spread, and ends the attempt early if no N fits.

findings.finding: The gate and the clamps are in milliseconds, not fractions of the period. KICK_WINDOW_MS 170 is +-0.49 beat at 345 ms (high-bpm-dnb) and +-0.46 beat at 370 ms (low-bpm-rnb before its 162 to 81 BPM halving, beatTracker.ts:140-149). Almost every beat has a kick 'in window', so the gate depends only on a 45 ms MAD. KICK_MAX_PHASE_MS 200 is more than half a beat on fast tracks, so the clamp does not protect them. The exit hysteresis (exit below N-2, so 3 of 8 with N=5) equals low-bpm-rnb's kick density (13 of 35 = 0.37). Once a lucky bar opens the gate it can stay open. K3 rates low-bpm-rnb's chance 'low' on N alone.
findings.suggestion: Express window and clamps as fractions of the period (or take min(ms, fraction x period)). Make the exit threshold tighter than the density of the tracks that must stay out, for example exit below N-1 or an N-of-M that low-bpm-rnb's 0.37 cannot hold. Add a sparse-kick spec at 0.37 density with a 2-bar cluster.
findings.resolution: Fixed: window, spread and phase clamp are fractions of the period; exit below N-1; N chosen so low-bpm-rnb's density cannot hold it; sparse 0.37 spec with a 2-bar cluster.

findings.finding: The plan does not say what happens to the gate ring, phase trim sum and period trim when the tracker reset paths fire: setTempo halving (aligned=false and a re-search), doubleTempo (period halved, bins cleared), a rebuild with epoch++, the BEAT_LOST_BEATS re-search, and reset(). low-bpm-rnb goes through a halving on its way to 24.2 ms. A trim of 2% of the old period or a stale residual ring carried across a period change corrupts the first beats of the new grid. 'Never calls setTempo' covers only one direction. C1 (beatCount never decreases, epoch only on rebuild) is checked only against kick moves.
findings.suggestion: Add to S2 and AC4: gate ring, trims and the phase-move sum reset on halving, doubling, re-search and reset(). Add a spec that halving mid-engagement leaves no residual trim and does not bump gridEpoch.
findings.resolution: Fixed: halving, doubling, rebuild, re-search and reset() clear the ring, move sum and trim; spec in AC4.

findings.finding: scorecard --set (C5, S1) is under-specified and its baseline guard is only prose. 'npm run scorecard' bundles run.ts with the esbuild CLI before it runs (package.json:35), so constants are fixed at bundle time and run.ts cannot override them at runtime. A per-point rebuild with an esbuild plugin is needed, as scripts/onset-sweep.ts does. Plan D6 'reuse ablate's one-line rewrite' and S1 draft_paths list only scripts/scorecard/run.ts. Each of 24 points also writes the default --out and, with --write-baseline, BASELINE_PATH from the same invocation (run.ts:74-76). C5 says 'never with --write-baseline' without enforcing it, so an override run could become the baseline, or the S4 re-baseline could pick up a stale override. The plan also adds an 'overrides' field to the output json, which scorecard:check or the sidecar hash may reject.
findings.suggestion: Name the mechanism in S1 (esbuild plugin rebuild per point, like onset-sweep) and add the runner to draft_paths. Make run.ts exit non-zero on --set with --write-baseline, with a spec. Write each point to its own --out. Check that scorecard:check ignores or accepts the overrides field.
findings.resolution: Fixed: C5 is a per-point esbuild-plugin rebuild like onset-sweep, exits non-zero with --write-baseline (spec), each point has its own --out, and scorecard:check acceptance of the overrides field is checked in S1.

findings.finding: The loop arithmetic and the error budget are not shown. Only the period trim integrates r; the phase move is proportional and fights the onset correction (phase gain 0.4), so the steady-state residual is a nonzero weighted mix. The claim 'the kick PLL integrates r to zero' is true only for the period term. Kicks sit a median 31 ms before the taps, and KICK_LEAD_MS is fixed at 0, so tracking the kicks exactly costs 31 ms of the 40 ms budget and leaves 9 ms for the competing loop. The period trim is r/period times gain, and r is 0.3 beat, so gains 0.05 and 0.12 give 1.5% and 3.6% per beat. Against the 2% clamp that is saturation in one or two beats, so the KICK_PERIOD_GAIN dimension is effectively bang-bang. The trim is also invisible to consumers: updatePhase and meter use lastBeatPeriod without the trim (rhythmAnalyzer.ts:290-300, 208).
findings.suggestion: Write out the loop in S2 (units of r, gain and clamp). Choose period gains that do not saturate at r = 0.3 beat, and a KICK_LEAD_MS inside the 40 ms budget that the 31 ms lead allows. State whether the analyzer anchor period should include the trim.
findings.resolution: Fixed: loop written in the design with units; period gains 0.01 and 0.03 per beat do not saturate a 1% clamp; lead fixed at 0 (D9, 31 ms within budget); lastBeatPeriod includes the trim.

findings.finding: O2's core is a nearest-kick-preferring correction, which is on the do-not-repeat list ('kick-preferring correction alone, 149.5 ms in D11'). The plan says O1 is 'close to' that miss and never makes the same argument for O2. What separates them (gate, period trim, no freeze) are the very things A and B already tried in part. The plan gives no falsifiable statement for why the run should now reach 40 ms from 142.7 or 98.9 ms. summer2000 is the only target track, and the AC4 specs use synthetic kick streams that do not reproduce its 0.28 concentration.
findings.suggestion: Add to S3 or AC3 one sentence of predicted behavior to confirm or refute (for example: gate open on at least 70% of beats after 12 s, grid within 40 ms of the taps by 20 s) and record it per point. A miss then says which link failed.
findings.resolution: Fixed: AC3 records a falsifiable prediction per point (gate open on 70% of beats after 12 s, grid within 40 ms by 20 s and staying). Unlike the D11 correction it is gated, period-following, causal and shielded from old onset evidence.

findings.finding: The go/no-go wiring is loose. S3 both commits the grid and runs it, with no commit hash recorded between them, so 'committed before its first run' is not checkable. The winner rule is undefined when several points pass: AC3 says 'one point has summer2000 <= 40 ms with AC2 green', and no tie-break or order is given. S4 and S5 are both marked dependent on S3 with nothing selecting one. Q2 (whether pushKicks in eval/detect.ts and --set land on main on a no-go) is non-blocking but decides what AC6 'main keeps only S1's pushKicks plumbing' means. S1 draft_paths omit eval/detect.ts and beatTracker.ts, and eval/detect.ts is required by AC1.
findings.suggestion: Split S3 into register (commit, record sha in the plan) and run. Fix the winner rule in advance, for example the lowest summer2000 among AC2-green points, then the lowest gain. Make S4 and S5 conditional on the recorded verdict, and answer Q2 before S1 starts. Add eval/detect.ts to the S1 paths.
findings.resolution: Fixed: register (S3, sha recorded) is split from run (S4); winner rule in AC3; S5 and S6 run only on the recorded verdict; Q2 answered as D8; eval/detect.ts added to S1 paths.

findings.finding: Observability gap: trace:beats columns (C4) show engagement, residual and trims, but there is no per-point record of when the gate opened and closed, how often it chattered, or how many beats had a kick inside the window. K2 and K3 ask for 'read, not widen' on engagement outside summer2000, yet only grid point 1 is traced on all tracks and the scorecard table has only summer2000, low-bpm-rnb and a blocking-failure count. When a point breaks lonley or syncopation-no-kick, the cause would need a re-run, which is outside the registered grid.
findings.suggestion: Add an engaged-beat share per track to the scorecard json output of every point (a counter on the existing getters), and record it in the AC3 table next to the blocking failures.
findings.resolution: Fixed: engaged-beat share per track goes into every point's scorecard json and the AC3 table; trace records gate open and close events.
